summary: Backend-only verification of the AOTG deploy-fix. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_aotg_backend.py covering env-file presence, config-from-env (no hardcoded conn string), /api/ root, /api/health with MongoDB ping, and full /api/status POST→GET persistence loop (MONGODB_MIGRATE target). All 9 tests passed (100%). Supervisor 'backend' service is RUNNING (previous FATAL 'couldn't chdir to /app/backend' is resolved). MongoDB ping succeeds from the app process; health check reports database=connected. No Mongo _id leakage. Note: /app/frontend does not exist (this is a bare RN Android repo) — used http://localhost:8001 as BASE_URL since the deploy HEALTH_CHECK targets the pod internally on that port; test also honors EXPO_BACKEND_URL if later set.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean: env-driven config via load_dotenv, /api prefix router, async motor client managed by FastAPI lifespan (proper startup/shutdown), Pydantic models for I/O, ObjectId excluded via projection {"_id": 0}. No issues.

Minor: CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api). FastAPI still applies it because middleware is registered before the first request, but conventionally middleware should be added before routers to make ordering intent obvious. Not a bug — no action required.

backend/.env uses CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests to wildcard origins; harmless today (mobile app doesn't call this, and no browser client exists) but worth tightening if a web client is ever added.
seed_data_creation: Test created one status_checks doc with client_name='TEST_deploy_verifier'; cleaned up via mongosh deleteMany({client_name:/^TEST_/}) after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL is http://localhost:8001 for this repo (no /app/frontend, no EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_aotg_backend.py as regression. If ingress/EXPO_BACKEND_URL is later added, set env var EXPO_BACKEND_URL before pytest to test through it.
rca_of_issue: Original deploy failure was: '[BUILD] prepare build context: read envs: read env file backend/.env: no such file or directory'. Root cause: Emergent full-stack deploy pipeline unconditionally reads /app/backend/.env at build time and runs supervisor `uvicorn server:app` from /app/backend, but this bare RN repo had no backend/ directory. Fix (already applied by main agent): added /app/backend/.env (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS), /app/backend/requirements.txt, and a minimal FastAPI /app/backend/server.py with /api/, /api/health, /api/status endpoints backed by motor. Verified: supervisor no longer emits 'couldn't chdir', service binds 0.0.0.0:8001, DB ping succeeds, status CRUD round-trips through MongoDB. Deploy build+HEALTH_CHECK+MONGODB_MIGRATE steps should all pass.
